tools.name: studio_info
tools.description: What Squatch Stack (a software and hardware studio in the Missouri Ozarks) builds, and how to reach it.

tools.name: list_goods
tools.description: Browse the Squatch Stack shop (tees, hoodies, mugs and drinkware, hats, stickers, posters, totes, desk mats, stationery and accessories). Optional text search (matches a product's name or any of its design, colour or size options, and says which one matched) and kind filter. Prices in USD; tax and shipping are added at checkout.

query.description: Words to match in a name or in a design, colour or size option, e.g. 'hoodie', 'mug' or 'walk humbly'

tools.name: show_shop
tools.description: Show the Squatch Stack goods as an interactive shop the person can browse: photos, colours and sizes, and a Buy button that opens the shop's secure checkout in their browser. Use it when someone wants to look around or buy. Optional search words or kind narrow it. Apps without interactive views get the same list as text.

query.description: Words to match in a name or a design, colour or size option, e.g. 'hoodie', 'mug' or 'walk humbly'

tools.name: get_good
tools.description: Details for one Squatch Stack product by slug: description, every variant (design, color or size) with its variant_id and price.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Build Squatch Stack checkout links for the chosen variants. It does NOT buy anything: give the links to the person, who reviews the cart and pays on the store's secure checkout (tax and shipping calculated there).

tools.name: contact_draft
tools.description: Make a ready-to-send email link (mailto) to Squatch Stack with a fitting subject and body. It sends nothing; the person opens it in their mail app.

summary.description: One or two lines about what they want, placed in the body

tools.name: parse_buffalo
tools.description: Tag every word of a 'Buffalo buffalo ...' sentence as city, animal or verb, with a plain-English gloss.

tools.name: request_custom
tools.description: Leave a request in the Squatch Stack inbox: a custom shirt or piece, details or an update on something, help with an order, or anything else. A person reads every one and replies by email when the request includes an address. Returns a reference (SQ-XXXXXX) to check with request_status. It sends no email and charges nothing; the request and any address are kept for 180 days, then deleted. The address is optional and is included only when the person chooses to give it.

kind.description: custom = make something; details = more about a product or service; update = news on something already asked; order = help with an order; other

message.description: What they want, in their words: what, how many, by when

contact.description: Optional: the email address the person chose to give for the reply

about.description: Optional: a product slug or an order reference this is about

tools.name: request_status
tools.description: Where a request sent with request_custom has got to (received, read, replied, closed), and the studio's answer. With the private token (SQ-XXXXXX-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX) it shows the answer; with the short reference (SQ-XXXXXX) only the status. Never shows the original message or email address.

reference.description: The token (SQ-XXXXXX-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX) or reference (SQ-XXXXXX) request_custom returned

tools.name: support_options
tools.description: The ways to back Squatch Stack's open hardware and audio work: monthly tiers and one-time options with their price and what the supporter gets, GitHub Sponsors and the store. Gives a checkout link only for options whose card checkout is live; it never starts a payment (the person opens the link and pays). Squatch.CC LLC is a for-profit business; support is not tax-deductible.

tools.name: about_this_server
tools.description: Who runs this server, how to verify it, exactly what each tool can and cannot do, what is kept, and the limits. Use it when someone asks whether they can trust a link or a request.
